title: capraea cinerea
intro: Capraea cinerea, commonly known as the grey trumpet or white trumpet tree, is a species of flowering plant in the family Acanthaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory function, and exhibit antimicrobial properties.
